# Suitcase1H

Source: https://fuel.gazebosim.org/1.0/OpenRobotics/models/Suitcase1H — OpenRobotics, CC0-1.0.

USD, MuJoCo and GLB retain original metric scale and available textures. Collision: convex hull of visual mesh. Mass and friction are estimated. Rigid prop only: wheels, handles and fabric do not articulate or deform. Human attachment is not fitted. No screening logic or contents. See provenance.json for archive hash and transformations.
